question: Unsa nga dugang mga permit sa BFP ang kinahanglan para sa mga negosyo nga mag-imbak ug gasolina, kemikal, o combustible materials?
answer:
Wala akong impormasyon bahin sa Citizens' Charter tungod sa BFP tungo sa mga negosyo nga mag-imbak ug gasolina, kemikal, o combustible materials. Ang mga permit sa BFP sa mga negosyo ay hindi nakalalaman sa mga nakalagay sa Citizens' Charter.

However, based on the provided sources, it is mentioned that importers of fire extinguishers and fire fighting equipment are required to apply for either a Philippine Standard (PS) License (for manufacturers) or an Import Commodity Clearance (ICC) Certificate (for importers) [S2]. The fire extinguishers are subjected to tests based on the requirements of relevant PNS at the BPS Testing Center or DTI-accredited testing laboratories.

For product certification under the BPS Product Certification Scheme, manufacturers and importers of critical products, including fire extinguishers, are required to apply from the BPS [S3].

It is recommended to check the BPS website (http://www.bps.dti.gov.ph) for the list of products that are required to undergo product certification under the BPS Product Certification Scheme.
